text:
Devin: Heads-up — planning to rotate catalog alias origami/latest -> origami/3.1 tonight during the 02:00 UTC quiet window. Expected swap time ~5m, full traffic after a 10m canary. Will run smoke and perf checks. Ping if you can't be on-call.
Anya: ack, I'll be available at 01:50-03:30 UTC. Who's running the canary metrics dashboard?
Sam: I'll own the canary checks. Plan: 10% traffic for 10m, then 50% for 10m, then 100%.
Priya: Can you add the smoke script here? I'll run preflight tests.
Sam: smoke.sh is tiny — run:
```
# quick health + inference smoke
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"origami/3.1","input":"Hello"}' | jq .
```
Maria: Add latency + 95th percentile check. If p95 > 1200ms for >5m we rollback.
Devin: Rollback plan: alias back to origami/3.0, automated step in deploy job. Manual rollback steps in runbook: /runbooks/cat-rotate.md
Sam: infra-bot will announce the actual deploy and the canary switch. Can we gate on model checksum match? I pushed artifact sha256:ab12f4c9e3b7 to the registry.
Anya: Verified checksum on staging.
infra-bot: deploy-job triggered by @Devin — rotate alias origami/latest -> origami/3.1, canary schedule: 10% 10m -> 50% 10m -> 100%. CI smoke passed.
Priya: Quick question — does this require a config change in Dedicated routing? I've set a fallback route to origami/3.0 already.
Devin: No config change needed, routing rules respect alias. Fallback will kick in if health checks fail.
Sam: I'll set up alerts: canary_failure and latency_spike channels. Tagging @oncall for the window.
Maria: Note: quantized variant origami/3.1-8bit isn't live in some regions; we'll avoid routing to those nodes.
Anya: Anything for docs/SDK? We should bump model catalog metadata: description + new tags.
Devin: I'll file a tiny PR to model-catalog with the version bump. @Sam please approve when ready.
Sam: will review in 20.
Maria: Also leaving a small smoke test snippet for post-deploy continuous check:
```
# sample eval
python tests/e2e/smoke_query.py --model origami/3.1 --prompt "Summarize: Redwood is"
```
Priya: I'm happy to be backup if alerts fire.
Devin: Thanks all. Target swap at 02:00 UTC. If anything unexpected, call rollback and ping #eng-oncall. :thumbsup: 
Sam: noted, I'll post final "deploying" message 5m before.
Anya: good luck :)
